programme.title: Frendit
programme.desc: Monica kauhistuu, kun Pete aikoo ryhtyä vapaaottelijaksi. Phoebe järjestää Rossille treffit naisen kanssa, joka oli aiemmin kalju.

programme.title: Frendit
programme.desc: Jengi lähtee uimarannalle. Phoebe tapaa perheystävän, jolla on yhteyksiä hänen perheensä menneisyyteen.

programme.title: Frendit
programme.desc: Ross alkaa jälleen seurustella Rachelin kanssa otettuaan tahattomasti vastuun heidän suhteensa katkeamisesta. Phoebe tekee sovinnon äitinsä kanssa.

programme.title: Silent Library Suomi
programme.desc: Shhhh! Puoli Seitsemän meets Silent Library Suomi. Miten käy, kun mukana ovat Mikko Kekäläinen, Hilla Samola, Tuulianna Tola, Ella Kanninen, Olli-Pekka Kursi ja Illusia Sarvas? Juontajana Riku Rantala.

programme.title: Silent Library Suomi
programme.desc: Silent Library Suomi -kirjastossa nähdään taattua repeilyä, kun Sini Yasemin, Costee, Heviteemu, Monako, Van Hegen ja Valentin saapuvat kirjastoon. Kirjastossa kuria pitää Riku Rantala.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Liikenneryhmä suorittaa maastoliikennevalvontaa käsivarren erämaa-alueella. Vartioniemi ja Matinlassi auttavat asiakasta suksen korjaamisessa. Haltin päällä he saavat tiedon vatsatautiepidemiasta ja lähtevät levittämään tietoa tunturin retkeilijöille: juomavesi on keitettävä.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Sodankylässä saadaan hälytys häiriköstä kaupan pihalla, Kilpisjärvellä nuorella venäläisnaisella on ajokortti hukassa ja myöhemmin norjalainen rattijuoppo saadaan kiinni.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Rovaniemellä Jänkälä ja Vaarala selvittävät perheriitaa aamutuimaan ja osallistuvat lasten vapputapahtumaan. Liikenneryhmän partio ylikonstaapeli Vartioniemi ja vanhempi konstaapeli Peura suorittavat liikennevalvontaa Enontekiöllä. Norjan kieli aiheuttaa päänvaivaa.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Muoniossa Oja ja Brännare käyvät Kittilässä poliisien huutokaupassa valvomassa järjestystä ja tutkivat varastetun auton tapausta. He joutuvat myös lopettamaan hirven kolarin jäljiltä.

programme.title: Silent Library Suomi
programme.desc: Shhhh! Puoli Seitsemän meets Silent Library Suomi. Miten käy, kun mukana ovat Mikko Kekäläinen, Hilla Samola, Tuulianna Tola, Ella Kanninen, Olli-Pekka Kursi ja Illusia Sarvas? Juontajana Riku Rantala.

programme.title: Silent Library Suomi
programme.desc: Silent Library Suomi -kirjastossa nähdään taattua repeilyä, kun Sini Yasemin, Costee, Heviteemu, Monako, Van Hegen ja Valentin saapuvat kirjastoon. Kirjastossa kuria pitää Riku Rantala.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Inarissa vanhempi konstaapeli Sami Valle on johtamassa etsintäharjoitusta Vapaaehtoisen pelastuspalvelun kanssa. Sodankylässä vanhemmat konstaapelit Numminen ja Pikkukangas tekevät liikenteenvalvontaa taajaman ulkopuolella ja pohtivat uravalintoja.

programme.title: Ernst Märzendorfer, Slovak Philharmonic Choir, Slovak Philharmonic Orchestra And Kristiane Kaiser - Verdi - La traviata
programme.desc: This production of Giuseppe Verdi's popular opera La Traviata was performed outdoors at the St. Margarethen Festival in 2008 by the Slovak Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of Ernst Märzendorfer. Soloists Kristiane Kaiser, Magdalena Anna Hofmann, and Stefanie Kopinits perform in a striking physical setting against the backdrop of the Austrian mountains. Several men are courting the rich courtesan Violetta, but when she meets Alfredo, she chooses to live a new life with him. She then moves from Paris to the French countryside, but unfortunately is haunted by her past: Alfredo's father does not approve of his past and convinces her to abandon his son. Alfredo is ignorant of his father's torment and, thinking that Violetta has used him, he becomes furious. In the end, he understands that Violetta has abandoned him to be free, but it is too late. Reaching an incurable illness, Violetta dies in his arms.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado, Berliner Philharmoniker, Anatoli Kotscherga And Kolja Blacher - Europakonzert 1996: Saint Petersburg
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'. After the intermission, Kolja Blacher featured in the two 'Violin Romances' by Beethoven, followed by a performance of his 'Seventh Symphony'. The orchestra is led by maestro Claudio Abbado.

programme.title: Esa-Pekka Salonen And Los Angeles Philharmonic - In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features the Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece.

programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra - Bizet - Symphony in C
programme.desc: Enjoy a sparkling performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s famous Piano Concerto No. 1, by the incredible piano virtuoso Russian Daniil Trifonov, with Kent Nagano conducting the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, to prove once more how majestic and incredible classical music can be when it’s done right! The concert opens with the famous Air from Bach's Orchestral Suite No. 3. Also on the program are Berlioz' Le Corsaire and Bizet's Symphony in C major. Recorded at the Charles Bronfman Auditorium, Tel Aviv, in 2014.

programme.title: Julijana Sarac - Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 21 - III
programme.desc: Julijana Sarac performs the first/third movement of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 21 (“Waldstein”). The work was completed in 1804 and is considered one of Beethoven's greatest and most technically challenging piano sonatas.

programme.title: Les Dissonances - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Orchestra della Radiotelevisione della Svizzera And Heidrun Holtmann - Mozart - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 4
programme.desc: Discover the soloist Heidrun Holtmann as she performs Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 1, KV 37 and Piano Concerto No. 4, KV 41, accompanied by the Orchestra della Radiotelevisione della Svizzera. Conducted by Marc Andreae, the performance took place at the historic Teatro Bibiena in Mantua.

programme.title: Mikhail Pletnev - Bizet - L'Arlésienne Suite
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra (RNO) in a performance of Maurice Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 with Lucas Debargue as the soloist. The concert opens with a selection of music by Georges Bizet based on Alphonse Daudet's play 'L'Arlésienne'. The music is compiled by Mikhail Pletnev. The first movement of Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 contains five distinctive themes, of which three are reminiscent of jazz. Debargue's performance of Ravel's concerto is followed by Gabriel Fauré's Barcarolle No. 4. The performance was recorded at Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow as part of the Ninth RNO Grand Festival.

programme.title: Renaud Capuçon, Gerard Causse, Iddo Bar-Shai And Jean-Jacques Kantorow - Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, Mozart’s Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven-String Quartet No. 16, Op. 135
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Pierre Boulez - Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed. This piece is one of the most frequently performed works of the twentieth century. Pierre Boulez explains how he interpreted this composition with the Berlin Philharmonic.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig - Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically. The Norwegian premiere followed a few months later. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sinfonia Rotterdam, Conrad van Alphen, Octopus Symphonic Choir And Gulnara Shafigullina - Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 is widely considered Beethoven’s greatest composition. He completed this symphony in 1824, when he was almost completely deaf. This symphony is unique, since Beethoven included a choir and vocal soloists in the last movement, in which he set parts of Friedrich Schiller's poem “Ode an die Freude” (“Ode to Joy”) to music. The symphony consists of four movements: Allegro ma non troppo, un poco maestoso, Molto vivace, Adagio molto e cantabile, and Finale. The four vocal soloists are Gulnara Shafigullina (soprano), Claire Barnett-Jones (mezzosoprano), Matthew Newlin (tenor), and Frederik Bergman (baritone).

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Mark Perna - Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Mendelssohn - Trio No. 1 Op. 49
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky.

programme.title: Sinfonia Rotterdam And Conrad van Alphen - Tchaikovsky - Overture-Fantasy Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Overture-Fantasy “Romeo and Juliet”. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Tchaikovsky based his composition on Shakespeare’s famous play “Romeo and Juliet”. After finishing a first version of Romeo and Juliet in 1870, Tchaikovsky rewrote sections of the composition twice, completing the third and final version ten years later. The Overture-Fantasy opens with a slow introduction, primarily led by the clarinets and bassoons. The composition is dominated by its famous love theme, representing the love between Romeo and Juliet. This beautiful theme is introduced in the first half of the piece, played by the English horn and violas, and recurs in different sections of the composition. At the end, the love theme is heard in minor mode, which emphasized the tragic element of the story of the two lovers.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine And Bjørn Fjæstad - Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: In 2012, conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto and the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería released a critically acclaimed recording featuring violinist Philippe Quint. The Philippe Quint Plays Bruch, Mendelssohn and Beethoven album, recorded at Sala Nezahualcóyotl in Mexico City, showcased major classical concertos.

programme.title: Roberto Prosseda - Piano works by Mendelssohn
programme.desc: The Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (*1975) is considered one of today’s leading interpreters of Felix Mendelssohn’s piano repertoire. Prosseda’s discovery of unknown Mendelssohn compositions made the headlines throughout Europe and led to several releases on the celebrated Decca label. In the current recital, recorded in 2015 at Teatro alle Vigne in Lodi, Italy, Prosseda performs a selection of Felix Mendelssohn’s Songs Without Words (Lieder ohne Worte) (Op. 19 No. 1, Op. 38 No. 2, Op. 38 No. 6, Op. 53 No. 2, Op. 30 No. 6, and Op. 62 No. 2), Variations sérieuses, Op. 54, and Fantasie, Op. 28.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Brahms - Symphony No. 1, Op. 68
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra performed a program including Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 1.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the awakening of nature to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer And Budapest Festival Orchestra - Stravinsky - Jeu de cartes
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky. On the program is music composed for the ballet 'Jeu de cartes' (1937) and the Firebird Suite, No. 2 (1919). 'Jeu de cartes' is one of Stravinsky's neo-classical works and consists of three parts ('deals'). The Firebird Suite, No. 2 is based on the music from the ballet of the same name, which was written for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes and premiered in Paris in 1910.

programme.title: Tedi Papavrami - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Estonian National Ballet - Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most beloved pieces from the composer. The music has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairy-tale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Ben Stevenson is to this day considered one of the most important influencers of the American ballet art. For almost thirty years, he has been the art director of the Houston Ballet, and under his leadership the company has grown into an internationally acknowledged ballet theatre. Since the year 2003 he’s held the position of Artistic Director of the Texas Ballet. His stage productions have earned several awards and praise from the critics, and have been staged at Opéra de Paris, Canadian National Ballet, La Scala, Bavarian State Opera, London City Ballet etc. This performance of the Nutcracker is recorded at the Teatro La Fenice (Venice) in 2012. With the Estonian National Ballet and star dancers Vladislav Lantratov and Galina Laush.

programme.title: Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Brahms - Symphony No. 2, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim. A few decades later in 1877, Brahms completed his Second Symphony, which is often compared to Beethoven’s Sixth Symphony given its cheerful and pastoral character.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven-String Quartet No. 14, Op. 131
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Les Dissonances And David Grimal - Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The composer wrote the symphony between 1877 and 1878, and dedicated it to Nadezhda von Meck – an exceptionally wealthy widow and great admirer of Tchaikovsky’s music, whom the composer described as ‘my best friend’. Tchaikovsky explained in his letters that the symphony is characterization of the nature of fate. The work opens with a powerful motif in the horns and bassoons representing fate. The second movement expresses melancholy, whereas the third presents ‘fleeting images that pass through the imagination when one has begun to drink a little wine’. Although the ‘fate’ motif reappears toward the end of the final movement, the movement has a festive character. This performance was recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Gil Shaham, Maxim Vengerov, Daniel Barenboim And Itzhak Perlman - Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: 60th Anniversary
programme.desc: In 1996, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra celebrated its 60th anniversary with a gala led by maestros Zubin Mehta and Daniel Barenboim. This musical event features world-renowned soloists, including veteran violinist Isaac Stern, up-and-coming musicians Maxim Vengerov and Gil Shaham, as well as Pinchas Zukerman, Shlomo Mintz, and Itzhak Perlman. The evening begins with a moving speech about the early days of the orchestra. The evening's program continues with Bach's Concerto for Two Violins in D minor, BWV1043, Brahms's Symphony No. 2, Halvorsen's Violin, Violoncello and Viola Pass, Mozart's Serenade No. 6, K. 239., Vivaldi's Concerto in B minor for four violins and orchestra, and Weber's Oberon overture.

programme.title: Berliner Philharmoniker - Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed. The piece has the character of an appeal from the very start, when the four-note “fate” motif casts a spell on listeners. The German musicologist Armin Koch analyses the work, while the German Beethoven expert Wulf Konold illustrates the ingenious variations of the “fate” motif on piano, and also explains other features of this magnificent work.

programme.title: Pavel Baleff, Orchestre de l'Opéra de Limoges, Chœur de l'Opéra de Limoges And Ruzan Mantashyan - Dvořák - Rusalka
programme.desc: Bulgarian conductor Pavel Baleff conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Opéra de Limoges in a performance of Antonín Dvořák’s lyric fairytale opera Rusalka (1900). The work’s libretto is written by Czech poet Jaroslav Kvapil. Rusalka, an elusive water nymph, falls in love with the Prince, who happens to swim in her lake. Rusalka longs to become human herself so that she can be together with the Prince. The witch Ježibaba is willing to help Rusalka, but warns her that the transition to a mortal human being comes at a high price: the nymph will lose the power of speech. What is more, if mute Rusalka cannot keep the love of a human, she will be damned for eternity. Stage director Nicola Raab and TV director Arnaud Lalanne created a truly filmic production of Dvořák’s masterpiece. Among the soloists are Ruzan Mantashyan, Adam Smith, Rafal Pawnuk, Marie-Adeline Henry, Marion Lebègue, and Alexandra Marcellier. This performance was recorded at the Opéra de Limoges, France, in February 2021.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. The Third Piano Sonata, Op. 14 (also called Concerto for piano without orchestra by Tobias Haslinger) was composed in 1836 and dedicated to Ignaz Moscheles. In 1853 Schumann revised the work and added a Scherzo as a second movement. The final movement is reminiscent of Kreisleriana, Op. 16. Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has had the privilege of performing as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, among them Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Jodie Devos - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Ton Koopman - Bach - Works for organ
programme.desc: The Dutch musicologist, conductor, organ and clavecimbel player Ton Koopman specilizes in the performance of Early Music, in particular the music of Johann Sebastian Bach. Although Koopman performs across the globe with his Amsterdam Baroque Orchestra, Koopman is also a sought-after organist. In this broadcast in St. Mary's Cathdral in Leipzig, the treasured musician performs organ compositions by Johann Sebastian Bach: 'Wachtet Auf', BWV 645; 'Nun komm der Heiden Heiland', 'Fugue in g minor', 'Schmücke dich, o liebe Seele', and the 'Toccata in d minor'.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest. With the help of his animal friends, Peter outsmarts a villainous wolf and captures it, eventually leading it to the zoo. Maestro Prieto gives an introduction to the different parts of the suite. In each part, each character is represented by a different instrument or instrument section, offering a vivid introduction to the orchestra's instrumental families. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021.

programme.title: Vadim Repin And Murad Huseynov - Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange ay Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music. Murad, the main actor, will represent one of those characters carried by solitude that can be found in the romantic paintings of Friedrich. The overall atmosphere of the musical program is rather melancholic, tending either towards a certain musical lightness, or, on the contrary, towards drama. The production is a cinematographic accompaniment of the music and its performers.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Franck - Sonata for violin and piano
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and violinist Maxim Vengerov perform César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Zubin Mehta And Israel Philharmonic Orchestra - In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28. This episode of ‘In Rehearsal’ offers an intimate look at the dialogue between Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss’s tone poem together.

programme.title: Philipp Scheucher - PIAM - Semi-final: Beethoven and Liszt
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Philipp Scheucher (Austria, 1993) performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Fantasia Op. 77; Menuetto: ‘Moderato e grazioso’ from Beethoven’s Sonata No. 18 in E-flat major, Op. 31 No. 3; and Franz Liszt’s transcription of the first movement, ‘Allegro con brio’, from Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor. This performance was recorded at Nuovo Teatro Ariberto in Milan, in May 2021.

programme.title: Alessandro Marangoni - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Simon Rattle - Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: On November 14, 1987, a promising conductor made his Berlin Philharmonic debut with Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 6: Simon Rattle. In retrospect Rattle says, “I felt that I was finding my voice on that day.” Mahler’s multifaceted work is now again on the program when Sir Simon appears for the last time as chief conductor of the Berliner Philharmoniker in the Philharmonie in 2018. The wheel comes full circle. Mahler's Symphony No. 6 is often referred to by the nickname Tragische (Tragic). Mahler composed work during a happy time in his life, as he had married his wife Alma in 1902 and became father of his second daughter. This contrasts with the tragic and even nihilistic last movement of the symphony.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 And 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Early Music Festival - England, my England - I
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this festival theme, episode 1 of this two-part documentary offers a peek into the inner-city churches of Utrecht.

programme.title: Leonidas Kavakos And Yuja Wang - Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 3, Op. 108
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition. With Yuja Wang, an accomplished artist at young age herself, he forms a masterful duo of chamber music interpretation. The programme features Brahm's Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 1 in G major, Op. 78, also known as the Regensonate, Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 2 in A major, Op. 100, the Thuner Sonata, a portrait of the Swiss lake of Thun's peaceful scenery. It comes to a fiery and passionate finale with Brahm's Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 3 in D minor, Op 108.

programme.title: Michele Pasotti And La Fonte Musica - Da Caserta and Filipotti - Dulcedo et Subtilitas
programme.desc: Filippotto and Antonello da Caserta were the first Neapolitan composers whose music was preserved. It is anything but primitive: these two belong amongst the prominent representatives of ars subtilior and the melodic Italian style which musicologist Nino Pirrotta christened “dulcedo.” La Fonte Musica immerses itself in the heritage of the first Neapolitan School, and gives us a taste of both early notated compositions and the unwritten traditions.

programme.title: Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra And Shaun Smyth - The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers. Explore the fusion of arts, science and culture in the 17th and 18th centuries in this imaginative concert commemorating Galileo’s first public demonstration of the telescope. Actor Shaun Smyth narrates a compelling script while the musicians weave in and around a magical stage set by Marshal Pynkoski. Created and scripted by Alison Mackay.

programme.title: Hannu Lintu And Fins Radio Symfonie Orkest - Sibelius - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: In 2013, the Finnish conductor Hannu Lintu was appointed principal conductor of the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra. Lintu studied piano and cello at the Sibelius Academy and the Turku conservatorium in Sweden’s southeast. He started conducting at the Sibelius Academy. His many concerts with the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra in 2012 made him the obvious replacement for Sakari Oramo, who, after many years as conductor and concert master, terminated his contract in 2012. The orchestra specializes in the performance of Finnish music, but also performs the great masterpieces of Gustav Mahler and Béla Bartók. The Finnish composer Jean Sibelius is the orchestra’s favourite, as well as the conductor. In cooperation with Finland’s national public broadcasting company Yle, all seven Sibelius symphonies are recorded and broadcast. After a brief spoken introduction about the piece, the orchestra performs the complete symphony. After Sibelius was diagnosed with throat cancer in 1908, he changed his lifestyle as well as his approach to composition. Fearing death, he quit using alcohol and tobacco. Simultaneously, the harmonies in his works grew darker and more sombre. Devils and death are among the images conjured up by the gloomy sounds of this Symphony.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer And Budapest Festival Orchestra - Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. Remarkable is the work’s instrumentation: Bartók divided the strings into two groups that are placed on opposite sides of the stage, to create antiphonal effects. The program ends with Brahms’s Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa - Rachmaninoff - Sonata for Cello, Op. 19
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Discovering Masterpieces – Debussy – La Mer
programme.desc: This documentary presents Claude Debussy’s ‘La Mer’. This masterpiece of suggestion and subtlety richly depicts the ocean. As a specialist in French Impressionism, the British pianist and writer Paul Roberts introduces Debussy’s work with passion.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan And Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris - Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony. The customary long introduction is replaced by two powerful chords, followed by the introduction of the main theme by the lower strings. The slow second movement is a Funeral March, followed by a quick Scherzo. The fourth and final movement is dominated by a theme from Beethoven’s ballet music for ‘The Creatures of Prometheus’. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Balthasar-Neumann-Orchestra, Pablo Heras-Casado, Miah Persson And Rolando Villazon - Donizetti – L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: With Rolando Villazón directing and playing the title role, the world rushed for tickets to the Baden-Baden 2012 Pentecost-holiday opera. Following his directorial debut in 2011 (Werther, Lyon) the Mexican tenor went a step further, staging Gaetano Donizetti’s L’elisir d’amore and directing himself in the role of Nemorino. The film tells the story of this “story within a story” and reveals the creative process of staging the comic opera in two acts at the Festspielhaus Baden-Baden in April and May 2012. We follow Rolando Villazón in rehearsals with singers and actors, and in his exchanges with young conductor Pablo Heras-Casado on the way to a highly personal performance.

programme.title: Thomas Zehetmair, Ivan Fischer And Budapest Festival Orchestra - Prokofiev - Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky. On the program is music composed for the ballet 'Jeu de cartes' (1937) and the Firebird Suite, No. 2 (1919). 'Jeu de cartes' is one of Stravinsky's neo-classical works and consists of three parts ('deals'). The Firebird Suite, No. 2 is based on the music from the ballet of the same name, which was written for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes and premiered in Paris in 1910.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Schumann - Fantasiestücke Op. 73
programme.desc: In Geneva, the city where she spent the most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play in private chamber music. Between each piece, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit, in an intimate interview that brings both their intimacy and the music. On the program are Ludwig van Beethoven’s 7 variations after The Magic Flute; Robert Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 73; Frédéric Chopin’s Introduction And Polonaise, Op. 3; ‘Lerchengesang’ (No. 2) from Johannes Brahms’s 4 Gesänge, Op. 70; and ‘Largo’ from Chopin’s Cello Sonata in G minor, Op. 65. This broadcast was recorded on November 12 and 13, 2020, in Geneva, Switzerland.

programme.title: David Levy - Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S. Bach’s famous The Well-Tempered Clavier (BWV 846-893), a collection of forty-eight preludes and fugues published in two books. A panel member at Leipzig’s Bach competition, Shostakovich was deeply inspired by Russian pianist Tatiana Nikolayeva’s performance of Bach’s 48 Preludes and Fugues. Shostakovich wrote these pieces between the autumn of 1950 and February 1951, dedicating them to Nikolayeva, who agreed to perform the Leningrad premiere in December 1952. David Levy’s performance was recorded at the Budapest Music Center, Hungary, in September 2023.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim, Berliner Philharmoniker And Alisa Weilerstein - Europakonzert 2010 - Oxford
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra performed a program including Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 1. The young American cellist Alisa Weilerstein, who has attracted widespread attention for her passionate yet precise musicianship, joined the orchestra for a breathtaking performance of Edward Elgar’s Cello Concerto.

programme.title: Gottfried von der Goltz - Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret? The internationally acclaimed pianist and Bach expert Robert Levin provides an answer.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado, Berliner Philharmoniker, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir And Swedish Radio Choir - Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Beethoven's Symphony no 9 is interpreted by the Berlin Philharmonic under former chief conductor Claudio Abbado at the Berliner Philharmonie in 2001. The recording features interpretations that are the fruit of decades of Claudio Abbado’s involvement with Beethoven. Listening to the music, one hears how the Berlin Philharmonic transforms Abbado’s musical intentions into sound – there is a sense of unity that can only be achieved through many years of shared artistic experience and attention to detail.

En quête d'un mode de vie différent, sobre et sauvage, ces jeunes quadragénaires ont tout quitté et économisé de longues années pour vivre leur rêve. Matthieu Fournier les rejoint pour les premiers coups de pagaie d'un long voyage plein d'imprévus.Premiers remousLe duo est confronté aux premières difficultés lors de la descente de l'Aar. Inexpérimentés, Aline et Olivier découvrent ce moyen de navigation qui devrait les amener jusqu'au cap Nord. Il leur reste plus de 5 600 km à parcourir et de nombreux obstacles à franchir, dont quantité de barrages hydroélectriques. Et ça, ils ne l'avaient pas prévu !

He varastavat Marseillessa paikallisen mafiapomon Jacomo Morierin silmäterän, harvinaisen ja mittaamattoman arvokkaan Bugattin vuodelta 1937. Morier päättää käyttää veljesten lahjoja omiin tarkoituksiinsa ja pitkäaikaista vihamiestään Max Klempia vastaan. Sophie on kuitenkin pian vaarassa, kun kiltin jätin isoveljet Fleshlumpeater, Bloodbottler ja Maidmasher huomaavat tytön. programme.title: Muuttomatka (0)

programme.title: Not Without Hope (15)
programme.desc: Parhaat ystävykset Nick Schuyler ja Will Bleakley sekä NFL-pelaajat Marquis Cooper ja Corey Smith lähtevät kalastamaan yli sadan kilometrin päähän Meksikonlahdelle. Myrskyn lähestyessä pojat irrottavat juuttunutta ankkuria, kun vene kaatuu ja ja he sinkoutuvat hyiseen veteen. Yhdysvaltain rannikkovartioston kapteeni Timothy Close johtaa pelastusoperaatiota raivoavassa meressä, kun ystävykset kamppailevat valtavia aaltoja, nestehukkaa, vakavaa hypotermiaa – ja jopa haita vastaan pysyäkseen hengissä.

programme.title: The Last Showgirl (15)
programme.desc: Hienostuneen tanssijan on keksittävä uudet tulevaisuuden suunnitelmat, kun hänen esityksensä lakkautetaan äkillisesti 30 vuoden jälkeen.

programme.title: Four Letters of Love (12)
programme.desc: Nicholas ja Isabel ovat eläneet hyvin erilaista elämää, mutta jokin on aina vetänyt heitä yhteen. He tapaavat vasta aikuisiällä tajuamatta, kuinka kauan heidän kohtalonsa ovat olleet sidoksissa toisiinsa. Four Letters of Love on hiljainen ja kohtalokas rakkaustarina menetetyistä mahdollisuuksista, odottamattomista kohtaamisista ja näkymättömästä voimasta, joka tuo ihmiset yhteen. Niall Williamsin menestysromaaniin perustuvan elokuvan pääosissa nähdään Pierce Brosnan (Mamma Mia!, James Bond) ja Helena Bonham Carter (Les Misérables, Kuninkaan puhe).

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends (12)
programme.desc: Kungfu-lupaus valmistautuu eeppiseen kamppailumittelöön kahden legendan ohjauksessa.

programme.title: High Rollers (15)
programme.desc: Suuren ja onnistuneen ryöstön jälkeen mestarivaras Mason elää täydellistä elämää rakastettunsa, Deckerin, kanssa. Unelma murenee, kun hänen arkkivihollisensa, armoton Salazar, kidnappaa Deckerin ja pakottaa Masonin ja hänen tiiminsä toteuttamaan lähes mahdottoman kasinoryöstön. Vaakakupissa on Deckerin henki. Salazarin yhtä armottomien kilpailijoiden saartamana sekä FBI kannoillaan Mason panee kaiken peliin – saavuttaakseen sekä jättipotin, että sen suurimman voiton: rakkaan Deckerin hengissä takaisin.

programme.title: It Lives Inside (15)
programme.desc: Sam yrittää epätoivoisesti sopeutua kouluun ja hylkää intialaisen kulttuurinsa ja perheensä ollakseen kuin kaikki muut. Kun mytologinen demoninen henki tarttuu hänen entiseen parhaaseen ystäväänsä, Samin on selvitettävä perimänsä, jotta hän voi voittaa sen.

programme.title: The Crow (15)
programme.desc: Sielunkumppanit Eric Draven ja Shelly Webster murhataan julmasti, kun demonit Shellyn synkästä menneisyydestä yllättävät heidät.

programme.title: Anyone But You (15)
programme.desc: Bea ja Ben näyttävät täydelliseltä pariskunnalta, mutta mahtavien ensitreffien jälkeen tapahtuu jotain, joka viilentää intohimoisen viehätyksen jääkylmäksi – kunnes he törmäävät yllättäen toisiinsa Australiassa järjestettävissä häissä.

programme.title: We Live in Time (12)
programme.desc: Elämänmakuinen tarina seuraa nosteessa olevaa kokkia, Almutia, ja hiljattain eronnutta Tobiasta, joiden odottamaton kohtaaminen muuttaa heidän elämänsä suunnan.

programme.title: Not Without Hope (15)
programme.desc: Parhaat ystävykset Nick Schuyler ja Will Bleakley sekä NFL-pelaajat Marquis Cooper ja Corey Smith lähtevät kalastamaan yli sadan kilometrin päähän Meksikonlahdelle. Myrskyn lähestyessä pojat irrottavat juuttunutta ankkuria, kun vene kaatuu ja ja he sinkoutuvat hyiseen veteen. Yhdysvaltain rannikkovartioston kapteeni Timothy Close johtaa pelastusoperaatiota raivoavassa meressä, kun ystävykset kamppailevat valtavia aaltoja, nestehukkaa, vakavaa hypotermiaa – ja jopa haita vastaan pysyäkseen hengissä.

programme.title: The Last Showgirl (15)
programme.desc: Hienostuneen tanssijan on keksittävä uudet tulevaisuuden suunnitelmat, kun hänen esityksensä lakkautetaan äkillisesti 30 vuoden jälkeen.

programme.title: Four Letters of Love (12)
programme.desc: Nicholas ja Isabel ovat eläneet hyvin erilaista elämää, mutta jokin on aina vetänyt heitä yhteen. He tapaavat vasta aikuisiällä tajuamatta, kuinka kauan heidän kohtalonsa ovat olleet sidoksissa toisiinsa. Four Letters of Love on hiljainen ja kohtalokas rakkaustarina menetetyistä mahdollisuuksista, odottamattomista kohtaamisista ja näkymättömästä voimasta, joka tuo ihmiset yhteen. Niall Williamsin menestysromaaniin perustuvan elokuvan pääosissa nähdään Pierce Brosnan (Mamma Mia!, James Bond) ja Helena Bonham Carter (Les Misérables, Kuninkaan puhe).

programme.title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues (15)
programme.desc: Englannin kovaäänisin ja täsmällisin bändi kokoontuu pitkän tauon jälkeen viimeiselle keikalleen.

programme.title: Here (7)
programme.desc: Here-elokuva kertoo perheistä, jotka elävät tietyssä samassa paikassa eri aikakausina. Tarina kulkee ajan halki, vangiten ihmiselämän aidoimmillaan sukupolvesta toiseen.

programme.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey (15)
programme.desc: Jotkut ovet vievät menneeseen. Toiset johdattavat tulevaisuuteen. Ja jotkut ovet muuttavat aivan kaiken. Sarah (Margot Robbie) ja David (Colin Farrell) ovat kaksi sinkkua, jotka tapaavat yhteisten ystäviensä häissä ja päätyvät pian vaikuttavallematkalle. Hauskalla ja fantastisella seikkailulla kumpikin heistä saa elää uudestaan menneisyytensä tärkeitä hetkiä ja kenties muuttaa tulevaisuuttaan.

programme.title: Isäni Goodrich (12)
programme.desc: Andy Goodrichin elämä kääntyy päälaelleen, kun hänen vaimonsa menee yllättäen vieroitushoitoon, jättäen hänet yksin huolehtimaan heidän pienistä lapsistaan. Goodrich tukeutuu ensimmäisen vaimonsa kanssa olevaan aikuiseen tyttäreen Graceen, joka odottaa ensimmäistä lastaan. Goodrich on uuden edessä, kun hän ensimmäistä kertaa elämässään joutuu tekemään epäitsekkäitä päätöksiä ja kehittyy isäksi, jota Grace ei koskaan saanut.

programme.title: Rust (15)
programme.desc: 1880-luvun Wyomingissa orpopoika Lucas Hollister tappaa vahingossa karjatilan omistajan ja hänet tuomitaan hirtettäväksi. Etäinen isoisä, kuuluisa lainsuojaton Harland Rust, saapuu pelastamaan hänet, ja vie hänet pakomatkalle kohti Meksikoa.

programme.title: Night Swim (15)
programme.desc: Entinen baseball-pelaaja Ray joutuu jäämään varhaiseläkkeelle rappeuttavan sairauden vuoksi. Ray muuttaa vaimonsa Even sekä teini-ikäisen tyttärensä ja nuoren poikansa kanssa uuteen kotiin. Ammattilaiskentille paluusta haaveileva Ray vakuuttaa vaimolleen, että lapset nauttivat uuden kodin uima-altaasta. Talon menneisyyden synkkä salaisuus vapauttaa voiman, joka vetää perheen kauhun syövereihin.

programme.title: High Rollers (15)
programme.desc: Suuren ja onnistuneen ryöstön jälkeen mestarivaras Mason elää täydellistä elämää rakastettunsa, Deckerin, kanssa. Unelma murenee, kun hänen arkkivihollisensa, armoton Salazar, kidnappaa Deckerin ja pakottaa Masonin ja hänen tiiminsä toteuttamaan lähes mahdottoman kasinoryöstön. Vaakakupissa on Deckerin henki. Salazarin yhtä armottomien kilpailijoiden saartamana sekä FBI kannoillaan Mason panee kaiken peliin – saavuttaakseen sekä jättipotin, että sen suurimman voiton: rakkaan Deckerin hengissä takaisin.

programme.title: It Lives Inside (15)
programme.desc: Sam yrittää epätoivoisesti sopeutua kouluun ja hylkää intialaisen kulttuurinsa ja perheensä ollakseen kuin kaikki muut. Kun mytologinen demoninen henki tarttuu hänen entiseen parhaaseen ystäväänsä, Samin on selvitettävä perimänsä, jotta hän voi voittaa sen.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends (12)
programme.desc: Kungfu-lupaus valmistautuu eeppiseen kamppailumittelöön kahden legendan ohjauksessa.

programme.title: SafariLIVE Sunrise
programme.desc: Jump on board a real LIVE safari from Africa as the sun is rising. Follow and interact with the real life stories of some of Africa’s most iconic animals.

programme.title: Luontoretkellä: Aistit
programme.desc: Mitä aisteja eläimet käyttävät? Katsojavideot vievät tänään eläinten hulvattomaan maailmaan, ja Kari tekee läheistä tuttavuutta lepakoiden kanssa. Norjalainen sarja mielenkiintoisista luonnontieteellisistä ilmiöistä.

programme.title: Sportliv
programme.desc: Ilman nyrkkeilyä, olisi hän parhaassa tapauksessa istunut vankilassa, uskoo moninkertainen SM-mitalisti Albert Thiangdee. Suunnanmuutos sai alkunsa, kun hän päihtyneenä ja verisenä, 13-vuotiaana, vietti uuttavuotta Pietarsaaressa.

programme.title: Bussi
programme.desc: Postin keltainen. Posti oli kerran Suomen vanhin ja suurin linja-autoalan kuljetusliike. Nykyään Postin keltaiset bussit ovat muisto vain. Tom Backmansson, 2006.

programme.title: Camilla Hamid ja leivosten Marokko
programme.desc: Aloitusjaksossa seuraamme Camillan matkaa ex-miehensä perheen luokse Casablancaan. Sieltä alkaa kaksiviikkoinen leivontaseikkailu, jonka aikana Camilla opettelee tekemään Marokon herkullisimpia leivonnaisia ankaran ex-anoppinsa opastuksella.

programme.title: Tiettömän taipaleen takana
programme.desc: Line ja Tor-Evert Grøndal asuvat kahden lapsen kanssa 52 neliön asunnossa keskellä metsää, omissa oloissaan kaukana päivähoitopalveluista. Se vaatii veronsa, mutta eräänä päivänä tapahtuu jotain maagista.

programme.title: Huutokauppakesä
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen sarja, jossa kaksi joukkuetta saa käyttöönsä saman summan rahaa ja kilpailee antiikkihuutokaupassa parhaista löydöistä. Asiantuntijat arvioivat ostot ja niiden oikean arvon.

programme.title: Jokaisen miehen takana (12)
programme.desc: Naja ja Michael haluavat avata yhdessä oman ravintolan, mutta arkkivihollinen Mikkel ja sijoittaja Cecilie laittavat kapuloita orastavan yhteistyön rattaisiin.

programme.title: Jokaisen miehen takana (12)
programme.desc: Päivä golfkentällä ruokakriitikon kanssa luo henkilökunnalle paineita. Flemming näyttää Emmalle, kuinka hankalia asiakkaita käsitellään.

programme.title: Richard Olsson - häpeämätön yritysjohtaja
programme.desc: Ruotsalaista yritysjohtajaa Richard Olssonia syytetään asiakkaiden huijaamisesta ja ihmisten elämillä pelaamisesta. Itse hän ajattelee olevansa vain kova neuvottelija, joka tekee kaikkensa varmistaakseen asiakkaiden voiton. Piilouduttuaan pitkään julkisuudelta hän kutsuu SVT:n toimittajat luokseen, koska haluaa kertoa asianajotoimistosta, joka teki hänestä rikkaan. Olsson ei kuitenkaan tiedä, että toimittajat voivat pian kuunnella hänen puheluitaan. Salaiset nauhoitukset piirtävät kuvan häpeämättömästä vallan väärinkäyttäjästä, joka manipuloi sekä asiakkaitaan että työntekijöitään.

programme.title: Gran Hotel (12)
programme.desc: Andrésilla on käsissä omantunnonkysymys. Saako Javier haluamansa? Hotelliin asettunut Ayala pitää korvat höröllä, kun Alarcónin suku kohtaa päivällispöydässä. Isabel punoo lemmenjuonia.

programme.title: Lolita Lobosco (12)
programme.desc: Jälleen uusi tyttö on kateissa. Koska liikkeellä on tiettyyn naistyyppiin fiksoitunut sarjamurhaaja, poliisin on pakko asettaa hänelle elävä syötti. Se voi päättyä ikävästi.

programme.title: Gigantit
programme.desc: Valmentaja Ole Martin rakastaa joukkueiden kannatuslauluja. Nyt hän on sitä mieltä, että Giganttienkin pitää saada omansa. Hän pyytää apuun ammattilaisen, joka lyö pelaajat ällikällä.

programme.title: Kaipuu maalle
programme.desc: Lattialämmityksen asentaminen ei suju niin kuin Strömsössä, ja yhtäkkiä Kimillä ja Amandalla on käsissään 70 metriä itsepäistä putkea taltutettavana. Kesä tuo mukanaan paljon edistystä talolla, mutta syksyn tullen vuokra-asuntoon alkaa sataa sisään ja muuttohalut kovenevat entisestään.

programme.title: Eva-Li Euroopassa
programme.desc: Matkan viimeinen määränpää on Lontoo, missä Eva-Li pääsee tutustumaan paikalliseen pubikulttuuriin yhdessä vuosia siellä asuneen lentoemäntä Idan kanssa. Sitten edessä on paluu Helsinkiin. Mutta mistä kaupungista Eva-Li vaikuttui eniten?

programme.title: Kenraalin salaisuus
programme.desc: Gunilla Boëthiuksen elämä ja identiteetti järkkyvät, kun hän saa 73-vuotiaana kuulla totuuden alkuperästään. DNA-testi paljastaa hänen biologiseksi isäkseen suomalaisen sotasankarin, kenraali Paavo Talvelan. Gunillalta totuuden salanneet ovat jo kauan sitten menehtyneet, eikä heitä enää voida vaatia tilille. Kuka Gunilla oikeastaan on? Onko hän sodan varjossa syntynyt rakkauslapsi eikä suinkaan yhteiskunnallisen keskustelijan C. G. Boëthiuksen esikoinen? Nyt Gunillan täytyy seurata Paavon jalanjälkiä löytääkseen itsensä. Tuotanto: SVT, 2024.

programme.title: Näin Ruotsi rakennettiin
programme.desc: Onko vika arkkitehtuurissa? Lähde mukaan Kortedalaan, Vällingbyhyn, Skärholmeniin ja Rosengårdiin. Matka vie meidät aikansa huippumoderneista 1950-luvun lähiöistä betoniteollisuuden miljoonaohjelmiin. Mistä tulee lähiöitä nykyään leimaava ulkopuolisuuden tuntu? Miltä lähiöiden valoisampi tulevaisuus voisi näyttää?

programme.title: Invisible Heroes (12)
programme.desc: lähetystössä piilotellaan tärkeää sosialistijohtajaa, joka aiotaan salakuljettaa maasta. Poliittinen tilanne kiristyy ja pakolaiset turhautuvat dramaattisin seurauksin.

programme.title: Kunnia (12)
programme.desc: Nora pelkää vanhempiensa päässeen hänen jäljilleen ja pakenee Oslosta. Stovnerissa pakkoavioliittoa koskeva oikeusjuttu ratkeaa.

programme.title: Luontoretkellä: Leikki
programme.desc: Mitkä eläimet ovat leikkisiä, ja miksi ne leikkivät? Tänään nähdään jälleen hauskoja katsojavideoita. Kari liittyy mäyrien seuraan. Norjalainen sarja mielenkiintoisista luonnontieteellisistä ilmiöistä.

programme.title: Vatsani ja minä
programme.desc: 25/30. Linn valmistautuu tapaamaan vauvansa ensimmäisen kerran. Joidenkin ihmisten käytös suututtaa Idaa. Sekä Emma että Emily kokevat kunnon yllätyksen.

programme.title: Unelmakoti: dokumentti
programme.desc: On keskikesä ja Lisa ja Christoffer ahertavat muuttaakseen vanhan koulubussin uudeksi kodikseen. Kunnostustöiden aikana nikkarit asuvat leirintäalueella Söderköpingin lähellä yhdessä ystäviensä kanssa. Lisan ja Christofferin ystäville bussiasuminen on tuttua jo pitkältä ajalta. Vasta-alkajille taas kulkupelin muokkaaminen kodiksi osoittautuu paljon luultua vaikeammaksi.

programme.title: Näin Ruotsi rakennettiin
programme.desc: Onko vika arkkitehtuurissa? Lähde mukaan Kortedalaan, Vällingbyhyn, Skärholmeniin ja Rosengårdiin. Matka vie meidät aikansa huippumoderneista 1950-luvun lähiöistä betoniteollisuuden miljoonaohjelmiin. Mistä tulee lähiöitä nykyään leimaava ulkopuolisuuden tuntu? Miltä lähiöiden valoisampi tulevaisuus voisi näyttää?

programme.title: Vaiheikas vuosi 1967
programme.desc: Jonas Fohlin ja Kjell Tunegård käyvät läpi Ruotsin vuotta 1967. Liikenne siirtyi oikealle, Maharishi Manesh Yogi puhui Skånessa meditaatiosta, Fåglumin veljekset saivat kunniamitalin ja Jimi Hendrix tuli vierailulle.
